Note

1. Tournament of 6

Every candidate is arranged according to their registration order. Example: the first person who registered is placed in Block A. Players are selected according to this:

Better performing and least performing players are ranked accordingly into S1, S2 and E.

  • S1 and S2 are for the better performers, and E is for the least.
  • S1 and S2 play a 1 vs 1 match. The winner advances to the finals. The loser plays a match against the person placed in E.
  • Whoever wins that match advances to the finals. The person who loses is considered third.

Prize distribution

  • The finals winner wins $80
  • The runner-up wins $40
  • The third place wins $25

2. Tournament of 4

Every candidate is arranged according to their registration order. Example: the first person who registered is placed in Block A. Players are selected according to this:

  • The winners advance to S1 and S2.
  • The person who wins in S1 and S2 is the final winner, and the loser is the runner-up.

Prize distribution

  • First place wins $50
  • The runner-up wins $25

There is no third prize in the Tournament of 4.
